# Commands

What the bot does in a server, one page per command group. Each page lists the
options of every command, who can run it, and an example of the bot's reply.

- [`/autochannel`](autochannel.md): Voice channels of your own, made by joining the hub channel
- [`/autoreassign`](autoreassign.md): Give members who leave and rejoin the roles they had
- [`/bot-commands`](bot-commands.md): Inspect and manage the bot's application commands
- [`/channel-utils`](channel-utils.md): Manage channels
- [`/fuel`](fuel.md): Track your car's refuels and fuel efficiency
- [`/invite`](invite.md): Invite the bot to your guild, or join its support guild
- [`/reminder`](reminder.md): Set reminders for yourself
- [`/stats`](stats.md): Show this server's member counts
- [`/steam`](steam.md): Get notified about free and discounted Steam games
- [`/team`](team.md): Teams of members that outlast any one tournament
- [`/tournament`](tournament.md): Run a team tournament: sign-up, a bracket, drafts and votes
- [`/uptime`](uptime.md): Show how long the bot has been running
- [`/urban`](urban.md): Look up words on Urban Dictionary
- [`/voice`](voice.md): Voice channel tools: split everyone in your channel into teams
